name: manual_139389
claim: Never hardcode a fixed relative offset (e.g. dollar-OPENCLAW_ROOT-slash-orama-system, or a literal dollar-HOME path) to locate a sibling repo in MCP/tool configs -- the checkout topology varies (orama-system can be a direct sibling of a caller, or one level removed/aunt to it, e.g. Perpetua-Tools nested under perplexity-api/). Use a cache-first, then walk-from-PWD (sibling and aunt cases), then bounded-find resolver instead.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22: found .codex/config.toml's exa MCP entry had silently drifted from a hardcoded ORAMA_ROOT-relative path to a completely different transport (npx mcp-remote to a public endpoint) -- likely because the original hardcoded path was fragile and someone worked around it rather than fixing the resolution. Both orama-system/.mcp.json and Perpetua-Tools/.mcp.json had the same hardcoded-HOME-path fragility. Fixed with a portable resolver (orama-system/scripts/exa/resolve-orama-root.sh) plus inline cache-first/walk/find bootstraps in each config, since MCP config launch commands can't depend on a script living inside the very repo they're trying to locate.
